purpose: Separate source-site registry supporting glossary expansion, player ingestion, fixture intelligence, market checks, weather checks and contradiction testing. This registry is subordinate to the NRL Master Glossary: terms drive research; sites are where evidence may be sought.
rules: The Master Glossary is the priority research index.
A site listing is not evidence by itself.
Prefer primary and official sources where available.
Use secondary sources for corroboration, divergence detection and market comparison, not silent substitution for primary evidence.
Record newly useful sites separately from glossary terms.
When a glossary term identifies a new research target, search the most relevant source class first and widen only as needed.

sites.name: NRL.com
sites.research_use: Fixtures, team lists, late mail, match reports, player profiles, official statistics, competition news and terminology.
